_readme: Companies whose careers pages the agent reads directly, through their
applicant tracking system. No API key, no quota, full postings.
Copy this file to companies.json and edit it. companies.json is
gitignored, so your target list stays private.
HOW TO ADD A COMPANY
Open the company careers page and read the URL.
boards.greenhouse.io/SLUG            -> ats greenhouse, slug SLUG
jobs.lever.co/SLUG                   -> ats lever,      slug SLUG
jobs.ashbyhq.com/SLUG                -> ats ashby,      slug SLUG
jobs.smartrecruiters.com/SLUG        -> ats smartrecruiters, slug SLUG
TENANT.wdN.myworkdayjobs.com/SITE    -> ats workday, slug TENANT,
wd N, site SITE
HOST (career.company.com, SAP)       -> ats successfactors, slug HOST
SuccessFactors has no public JSON API, so that adapter reads the Google
Jobs RSS feed a Career Site Builder site publishes at HOST/sitemap.xml.
The slug is the career-site host, e.g. jobs.voith.com. If HOST/sitemap.xml
is not that RSS feed (a plain sitemap, a 404), the site is not reachable.
Workday needs all three. From
https://wattswater.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/External you get
slug wattswater, wd 5, site External.
max_jobs caps a single employer so a large board cannot flood the
digest. Bosch alone lists over 4,000 postings.
Every entry below was checked against the live endpoint AND the
returned job titles were read to confirm they belong to that company.
Do both. Searching the web for a Workday URL turns up plenty of live
tenants that belong to somebody else entirely, and a tenant that
returns 200 with 2,000 jobs looks identical to a correct one until
you read the listings.
Slugs change when a company switches vendor. A board that stops
responding is reported by name in the run summary, never hidden.
